name: submissions-pilot4-webR
description: Development repository for Pilot 4 WebAssembly Shiny App

paragraphs: Building upon the Submissions Pilot 2 in which a Shiny application created as an R package was successfully transferred to the FDA using the eCTD gateway protocol, the objective of Pilot 4 is to explore novel technologies to bundle the application along with the necessary execution dependencies and streamline the transfer and execution procedures. This repository contains the WebAssembly version of the application.
